headline: SEBI orders Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund Rs 546 crore
summary: Market regulator SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy and its founder to refund Rs 546.17 crore collected through unregistered investment-advisory activities.
why: Regulatory enforcement actions against unauthorized advisory services protect retail investors and enforce strict compliance across financial markets.

impacts.name: Financial Advisory Services
impacts.why: Stricter regulatory oversight curbs illicit advisory operations and enforces mandatory registration compliance.
